note: Ideas W10 Corner Nook (Hub): fortune cookie (I401), wish star (I509), note to your future self (I501), poster gift codes (I404), donation drive (I406), Konami jokes (I410). Cosmetic text and small credit payouts; nothing changes battles.
fortunes: A brave start beats a perfect plan.
Today, a Water type will save the day.
The next berry you find will be the one you need.
Someone on the road is thinking of you. It is probably a Pidgey.
Do not trust a gym leader who smiles first.
Rest is also progress.
A shiny waits in the tall grass. It does not mind being late.
Your lead is prouder of you than it shows.
A rival is only a friend who has not met you properly yet.
Something you lost will turn up in a Bag you forgot.
Luck is a muscle. Keep using it.
The third door is always the right one. Or the fourth.
A Poké Ball thrown with kindness lands softer.
You will meet a stranger. Say hello first.
Fire melts, water flows, grass grows. Pick your day.
Beware of Zubats before breakfast.
Your team has more heart than a gym has badges.
A small step today is a long road tomorrow.
The legend you chase is chasing you back.
Good things come to those who stop to read the sign.
Even a Magikarp has a very good day, once.
Do not fear the dark cave. It is only quiet.
Your next evolution is closer than you think.
A friend will share their last berry with you.
The weather will change. So will you.
Speak softly and carry a Revive.
Your first Pokémon remembers your first promise.
Today is a good day to try the other path.
The one who waits is not the one who loses.
Take a photo. You will want it later.
wishGifts: A shooting star left a feather at the door.
In the morning, a small ribbon is tied to the gate.
A glimmer of stardust settled on your trainer card.
A note on the doorstep: "Thanks for the wish."
Somebody left a warm berry pie on the sill.

jokes: +30 lives. (We do not have lives. Enjoy the sentiment.)
Cheat code accepted. Nothing happens. Perfectly harmless.
A Magikarp somewhere splashes in celebration.
You found the secret. The secret is: well done.
A distant Slowpoke finally gets the joke.

stamps.title: Stamp Collector
stamps.ceremony: The stamp-keeper presses a bright stamp onto your card, rings a little bell, and the whole room claps.

reputation.greeting: "They named a bench after you. We are not joking."

goodbyes: Your Pokémon waves from the Hub gate: "Come back soon!"
A little wave from the gate. Your team waves back.
The gate keeper tips a hat while your Pokémon wave goodbye.
Everyone at the Hub gate waves. Your lead waves back with both paws.
A Pidgey on the gate post flaps once. That is a wave.
